Match the attached reference images exactly: the same illustrated storybook look, the same soft dark outline around every shape, the same matte painted shading with no gloss, the same warm muted daylight palette lit from the upper left, and the same viewing angle the reference buildings are drawn at - seen slightly from above and very slightly from the left, with the shopfront almost face-on. Draw one subject only, centred, with generous empty margin on every side. No ground, no paving, no pavement, no street, no sky, no neighbouring buildings, no people, and no background of any kind: the entire background must be fully transparent.
A two-storey corner cafe building, complete from the ground to the top of its roof, and noticeably wider than it is tall - a broad street frontage, not a narrow tower. Ground floor: a warm cream-painted shopfront with large glazed windows showing a lit interior with shelves and cakes, a central wooden door, a wide cream-and-dusty-rose striped awning above the windows, and a hanging wooden sign board over the door with a painted coffee cup on it and no lettering. Upper storey: two tall sash windows with wooden window boxes full of green trailing plants and small pink and white flowers. A terracotta pantile roof with a small chimney. Climbing ivy up one side. Warm lamplight glowing in the windows.
